description: Limit who can see an event, or open it to everyone. Hiding an event from people changes what they see in the app, so only do it when the user asked.

eventId.description: The event id (from the matching list tool).

visibilityType.description: "all" = whole team, "roles" = only visibleToRoles, "custom" = chosen users/groups.

visibleToGroups.description: Group ids allowed to see the event (when visibilityType is "custom").

visibleToRoles.description: Role names allowed to see the event (when visibilityType is "roles").

visibleToUsers.description: User ids allowed to see the event (when visibilityType is "custom"; see list_tour_members).

name: set_event_visibility
title: Set event visibility
